geometry_edits.rationale: Wrap the existing dominant body in a split-wing composition so the mass can form a meaningful public void and better address neighborhood-living ground requirements.
Use the long axis to preserve the dominant bar logic while opening the frontage side.
Create a clearly readable void rather than a barely perceptible nick.
Keep a connective element so the mass remains one coherent composition while still opening to the street.
Add a ground-spine response to turn the access edge into a legible public threshold.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace the generic bar with a split-wing mass to create a clearer dominant gesture and allow a true public void at the access edge.
Keep the main mass organized along the long axis so the split can read as one dominant street building rather than fragments.
Enable a legible void/cut condition instead of a sealed bar at the frontage.
Insert a ground-connected public spine to repair the access edge and create usable threshold space.
Open the split enough to read as public void rather than a minor seam.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent object only in a narrow sense: it reads as a single bent slab in some views, but the visible mass is still largely a generic box with a shallow carve and no convincing public threshold. Across views the form is not strongly sectioned, the bend is subtle, and the access-edge response is weak relative to the explicit neighborhood-living brief that asks for an active ground edge and one clear public void or terrace. The form also does not establish a convincing hierarchy between primary mass and support/void, and the section does not suggest a meaningful residential/commercial ground relation or calm upper organization. Repair integrity is moderate because the mass is not visibly broken, but the overall massing is too inert and under-articulated for the program.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much taller tower-like precedent than this low-rise neighborhood-living bar; use only the idea of a coherent stepped profile, not the typology.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stepped/tapered massing can read as a single dominant figure when the profile is coherent and the upper mass remains legible.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Low-rise retail/cafe object with a different scale and frontage condition; not a direct massing template.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A small public-facing ground threshold with canopy/entry emphasis can strengthen neighborhood-commercial legibility.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual only; far more extensive and section-driven than the candidate, with a different overall spatial program.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Carved communal voids and terraced continuity can support neighborhood living when they are tied to a clear mass hierarchy.

warnings: Parcel containment appears satisfied, but the candidate does not exploit the parcel with a meaningful open-space figure.
The verified primary road frontage/access edge is not given a legible public void or entry seam; the ground response feels sealed/opposite to the brief.
Do not overread the shallow bend as a true section strategy; it is too weak to carry the neighborhood-living program.
Reject as program-fit failure rather than as a facade issue.
